# AnantSoftComputing

> AnantSoftComputing is a full-service software development company based in Vadodara, Gujarat, India. Founded in 2013, we design and build custom software, CRM systems, ERP platforms, iOS/Android mobile apps, and provide result-driven SEO services for businesses across India and globally.

## About

AnantSoftComputing (also known as Anant Soft Computing) has been delivering software solutions since 2013. Our team of 50+ engineers, designers, and consultants has completed 250+ projects with a 95%+ client satisfaction rate. We serve startups, SMEs, and enterprises across India, the USA, the UK, Australia, and the UAE.

**Headquarters:** 1 C Satyam Apartment, Vishwas Colony Alkapuri, Vadodara – 390007, Gujarat, India
**Phone:** +91-9638544455
**Email:** support@anantsoftcomputing.com
**Website:** https://anantsoft.com

## Services

### Custom Software Development
We build bespoke enterprise software tailored to specific business requirements — including ERP systems, hospital management platforms, Gaushala management systems, NGO platforms, and any complex web application. We handle the full lifecycle from requirements to deployment.

- Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
- Hospital Management Systems
- Gaushala (Cow Shelter) Management Software
- NGO & Non-Profit Platforms
- Custom Web Applications

### CRM Development
We design and develop custom Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems that help businesses automate sales pipelines, manage customer relationships, and gain data-driven insights.

- Contact and lead management
- Sales pipeline automation
- Analytics and reporting dashboards
- Third-party integrations (email, payment, APIs)
- Mobile-accessible CRM

### Mobile App Development
We develop native and cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android, focusing on performance, intuitive UX, and scalability.

- iOS App Development (Swift/SwiftUI)
- Android App Development (Kotlin/Java)
- Cross-Platform Apps (React Native, Flutter)
- Mobile UI/UX Design
- App maintenance and support

### SEO Services
We provide comprehensive search engine optimization services to help businesses rank higher on Google and other search engines and drive sustained organic traffic.

- Technical SEO Audit
- Keyword Research & Strategy
- On-Page SEO Optimization
- Link Building
- Local SEO
- Content Strategy
- Performance Tracking & Reporting

## Technology Stack

**Backend:** Python, Django, Node.js, REST APIs
**Frontend:** React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS
**Mobile:** React Native, Flutter
**Databases:** PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase
**Cloud:** AWS, Google Cloud
**Other:** Docker, CI/CD, Firebase, Stripe integrations

**What industries do you serve?**
Healthcare, retail, e-commerce, education, non-profit, agriculture, finance, and manufacturing.

**Where are you located?**
Vadodara, Gujarat, India — with clients worldwide.

**Do you offer post-launch support?**
Yes, we provide ongoing maintenance, updates, and support for all software we develop.

**What is your development process?**
Discovery → Strategy → Design → Development → Testing → Launch → Support.
